tasks.objective: Apply Biome safe formatting and import fixes across configured source files.
tasks.stop_condition: Safe fix command completes and remaining errors are inventoried.

tasks.objective: Resolve every remaining Biome error without intentional behavior changes.
tasks.stop_condition: Biome exits successfully or a concrete behavior-preserving fix is unavailable.

tasks.objective: Prove the repository still typechecks, tests, and builds after lint corrections.
tasks.stop_condition: All checks are classified and introduced failures are resolved.

tasks.objective: Review the material repository-wide diff for behavior changes and missed defects.
expected_outputs: Severity-ranked findings or explicit clean review
tasks.stop_condition: All valid material findings are resolved or precisely disclosed.

replan_triggers: Typecheck or tests fail after edits
Independent review finds a material behavior regression
Repository state changes outside the recorded baseline
